$comment: Desired grants for the root email, by name (agent/plans/PLAN-root-grants.md Design 2). Ids are resolved per region at run time by rediacc_ci.ops.root_grants. The email itself is ROOT_EMAIL in bws and is never committed.
Plan and tier are floors: a higher plan or tier stays as it is. `kind` is edge or bench only, so a stable target or an enterprise config is refused by the loader.

`bench_test_partner` is a second partner org for the sidebar walk-through (PLAN-account-sidebar-redesign Design 10). Its `targets` name bench targets only: an edge target there is refused with rc 2, and the account Worker refuses the section outside bench.
